segments.ja48:1.1: Anupāyena yo atthaṃ, icchati so vihaññati;
segments.ja48:1.3: Cetā haniṃsu vedabbaṃ [vedabbhaṃ (sī. pī.)], sabbe te byasanamajjhagūti.

lines: Tattha so vihaññatīti so anupāyena “attano atthaṃ vuḍḍhiṃ sukhaṃ icchāmī”ti akāle vāyāmaṃ karonto puggalo vihaññati kilamati mahāvināsaṃ pāpuṇāti.
Sabbe te byasanamajjhagūti tepi ca anavasesā aññamaññaṃ ghātayamānā byasanaṃ adhigacchiṃsu paṭilabhiṃsūti.
